mechanisms: X509_SIG repr(C) layout and offset/size assertions
file_dispositions.note: Both out-parameters are independently NULL-checked and both answers are borrowed, matching x_sig.c. The item layer is the established shared codec; no duplicate symbol is exported, matching the authority.

The embedded field's own address is handed to the item machinery, so free releases the algorithm's members and never the enclosing block. The embedded offset and the 32-byte stride are compile-time asserted.

mechanisms: X509_VAL repr(C) layout and offset/size assertions
file_dispositions.note: Two mandatory pointer fields with one owner per item; no _dup is exported, matching x_val.c.

mechanisms: AtomicPtr allocator slots with provenance-preserving recovery
OwnedFibre allocation and single release at (FILE, LINE_FREE)
file_dispositions.note: Callbacks run with the latch lock released, so they are reentrancy-safe; the latch, the unlock-before-store ordering and the default-function identity all match the authority. The repair records the CRYPTO_zalloc vs OPENSSL_malloc divergence (zero-filled stack) with the hook, size and coordinate unchanged. No code change.

mechanisms: n2l / l2n / n2ln / l2nn byte extents
BF_set_key cyclic key XOR and self-encrypting schedule
ECB, CBC, CFB64 and OFB64 block/partial loops
file_dispositions.note: Every pointer walk is bounded by the caller's stated extent and the length/num arithmetic matches the authority. The repair adds the authority's multiple-of-8 precondition to BF_cbc_encrypt, whose final whole-block arm would otherwise over-read on decryption for a non-multiple length. No code change.
A CAS loser releases its unpublished Box exactly once; the cached object is process-lifetime and BN_free honours the static flag. Declared array lengths give the expected widths.
Same static-BIGNUM idiom as bn_srp; every accessor answers the shared process-lifetime object and the test table covers all thirty-two widths and static/malloced flags.
The substitution delegates to BN_mod_exp_mont_consttime with the same refusal and error coordinate; no new unsafe operation.

defects_repaired.note: BF_cbc_encrypt's # Safety now states the authority's multiple-of-8 precondition, which the final whole-block arm relies on. Documentation-only, no behaviour change.

async_stack_alloc zero-fills through CRYPTO_zalloc where the authority uses OPENSSL_malloc; the allocator hook, request size and (FILE, LINE) coordinate are unchanged. Documentation-only, no behaviour change.
